home.description: Your goal: Get 🟩 on the gold framed cell. How? Tap a cell and it might transform, depending on what colors are around it. The hidden rules are different for each puzzle.
home.loadError: The puzzles could not be loaded. Please check your connection and reload the page.
home.privacy: No cookies, no tracking, no identifying data. Moves and results are collected anonymously to improve the game. Saved progress (only if you allow it) stays in this browser and is never sent anywhere.

consent.title: Save your progress?
consent.body: The game can remember on this device which puzzles you solved and your best stars, so you keep them next time. It is stored in this browser only and never sent anywhere.
consent.statusOn: Progress is saved on this device
consent.statusOff: Progress is not saved (this visit only)
consent.declineDeletes: Choosing “No thanks” deletes the saved progress from this browser.

halloween.description: Your goal: Get 🍬 on the gold framed field. How? Tap a field and it might transform, depending on what objects are around it. The hidden rules are different for each puzzle.

sorcerer.description: Your goal: Get 👑 on the gold framed field. How? Tap a field and it might transform, depending on what objects are around it. The hidden spells are different for each puzzle.

rules.title: How it works
rules.p1: Each puzzle has a hidden rule that determines how a field transforms when tapped. The rule considers the colors of the neighboring fields.
rules.p2: Understand the rules and make a plan how to get the winning object on the gold framed field.
rules.p3: Can you achieve the least number of moves possible? The fewer moves you need, the more stars you get.
rules.p4: Use {{retry}} anytime to start the puzzle from the beginning. Experiment to find out the hidden rules. After a win you can retry to get more stars by using less moves.
